name_note: The representative genome is labelled Faecalibacterium prausnitzii in NCBI; F. longum is one of the species recognised when the classical F. prausnitzii was split.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii has long been counted among the predominant bacteria of the healthy adult gut, and the genus has recently been split into several species including Faecalibacterium longum.
In a cohort of 1120 Han Chinese individuals, a Faecalibacterium longum strain showed the strongest inverse correlation with body mass index among the genus strains examined.
Given to mice, that strain prevented high-fat-diet obesity, improved glucose tolerance and lowered pro-inflammatory cytokines.
A reanalysis of inflammatory bowel disease metagenomes reported that strain's genome more abundant in healthy people than in ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease patients.
